items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Louie Armstrong had difficulties with his managing director... It appeared that Louie found out that Mr. Collins was making some, almost 20,000 pounds a week for him

ctx.x: when Duke was in there. Yes, that's just when it was. Yeh, 1933, and around about that time, Louie Armstrong had difficulties with his managing director, Mr. Collins, in London, and left there and there were some difficulties together.
It appeared that Louie found out that Mr. Collins was making some, almost 20,000 pounds a week for him, and Louie was getting about 100 pounds a week.
